subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence.

They __serve__ stuffed garlic bread and molten chocolate in the birthday party of their son, Parth, last week.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"serve"** means to provide food or drink to someone. (परोसना)

 
 
• **Example: **They **serve** dinner at 7 PM every day.
 
 
 
• **"served" **is the past tense of **"serve**" and it indicates that the action of serving happened in the **past.** (परोसा)
 
 
• **Example: **They **served** a delicious meal at the wedding last night.
 
 
 
• The given sentence require a verb that is in** simple** **past tense** as the word '**last night'** is mentioned in the sentence that means the action verb must be in *past tense.*

Therefore, the correct statement is '***They served__ stuffed garlic bread and molten chocolate in the birthday party of their son, Parth, last week.'*** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**The other options are **incorrec**t since they are **unable fulfill the requirement of tense** for the given statement.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Serves **(परोसता है): This is the present tense form of **"serve".**

 
 
• **Example:** She **serves** lunch at the community center every day.
 
 
 
• **Are serving **(परोस रहे हैं): This is the present continuous tense form of "**serve"**.
 
 
• **Example: **They **are serving** food to the homeless people right now.
 
 
 
• **Be served** (परोसा जाए): This is the** passive** form of "**serve"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The guests will **be served** a five-course meal.
